title: Crows Never Forget a Face
description: Crows can recognize individual human faces and remember people who treated them badly for years.

scenes.text: Crows can recognize your face, and they can remember it for years.
scenes.subject: crow
scenes.say: [whispers] Crows can recognize your face... and they can remember it for YEARS.

scenes.text: In one famous study in Seattle, researchers wore a mask while they caught and tagged crows.
scenes.subject: crow
scenes.say: In one famous study in Seattle, researchers wore a mask while they caught and tagged crows.

scenes.text: Years later, crows still scolded and dive bombed anyone who wore that same mask.
scenes.subject: crow
scenes.say: [angry] Years later, crows still scolded and dive bombed anyone who wore that same mask.

scenes.text: Even crows that were never caught joined in. They seemed to learn who to dislike from the others.
scenes.subject: crow
scenes.say: [gasps] Even crows that were never caught joined in. They seemed to learn who to dislike from the others.

scenes.text: So be kind to the crows. They are watching. Follow for more weird facts.
scenes.subject: crow
scenes.say: [nervous laugh] So be kind to the crows. [whispers] They are watching. Follow for more weird facts.
